# All EDs statistics

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Every emergency department's open movements and how long each has been open.

## What is on the screen

1. EDs at a glance. ED journeys open across the network, with the median, how many have no ward yet and how many are flagged urgent.
2. Statistics views. Network, Compare, Services, Wards, EDs, Teams and Weekly. Each opens its own page.
3. Compare. Opens Compare, with every ED side by side.
4. Open movements by ED. One dot per person, by hours since the movement opened. Show narrows to no ward yet or the longest.
5. Every ED. Journeys open, no ward yet, longest and median for each ED. Sort by any column.
6. Time since opening. Open movements counted in bands by how long they have been open.

## On a phone

- Every ED. Each ED's open journeys, busiest first. Open one for its own figures.

In Ward Flow, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
